last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 10
last_episode_to_air.overview: Sameer is all set to marry Natasha. But this news doesn't go well with Abha and Bandookwala as they plan to create misunderstandings between the lovers, but fail. But when Sameer realizes that Natasha is the daughter of the mafia queen of the state, Chandni. The marriage for which he was so excited becomes his biggest problem and he starts running away to save his life.

name: Dunali
overview: Troubled by an atypical medical condition that has a direct bearing on a young boy's sexual life, the world around him goes upside down wherein everyone tries to take advantage of his abilities. Some remain smitten while some are shocked when they find the double-trouble that he is blessed with. Watch the laugh-riot doubling its fun in Dunali.
